groups.defect: Javadoc for the void methods requireView() and requireViewClientScopes() says "Returns true if ..." when it should say "Throws ForbiddenException if ... returns false".
groups.rationale: The same copy-paste javadoc mistake appears on two neighboring require* methods. Each needs its own edit, but one wording fix covers both.

groups.defect: getClientsWithPermission adds the name of the type-level "Clients" resource to the set instead of real client IDs. Per-client resources are missed because they have no type attribute set, which also causes an NPE in the caller.
groups.rationale: Both report that findByType returns the all-clients sentinel resource, so the literal "Clients" ends up in the result. s_924e2d8b also reports the missing type attribute on per-client resources and the NPE in the caller.

groups.defect: ClientPermissionsV2.setPermissionsEnabled throws UnsupportedOperationException, but the ClientRemovedEvent listener in AdminPermissions calls it. This breaks client deletion and leaves per-client resources orphaned.
groups.rationale: Both report the same throwing method being called from the client-removal listener, and the same fix resolves both: make it a no-op or adjust the listener.
